## Sun Glimmer (G4)

Sun Glimmer is the *fandom-used name* for the aqua/seafoam unicorn filly with a golden-yellow mane and light-green eyes in Cheerilee's classroom. Her Sweetie Belle-like design makes her memorable: she appears near Archer (the blue Scootaloo lookalike), but she is **not confirmed to be Sweetie Belle in disguise**.

**Name and voice.** The television episode does not name her, and I found no verified official naming credit. In a 2013 drawing, artist flamefyre1235 called a version of the lookalike *Belle Pepper* before later acknowledging the existing *Sun Glimmer* name; that is an artist-created alternative, not a canonical alias. [Artist's drawing and naming note](https://ponerpics.org/images/7422377). No individually credited spoken line or voice actor was verified for Sun Glimmer.

**Appearances.** Her identifiable television appearance is *Call of the Cutie* (S1E12). Character indexes also place her on pages 1 and 3 of IDW's *Friendship Is Magic* #38 (January 2016), and in the first, second, and fourth *FUNdamentals of Magic* shorts as a pupil at Celestia's School for Gifted Unicorns. These are background appearances, not an established personal storyline. [Character appearance index](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Foals) · [Issue #38 publication information](https://data.mlpmerch.com/comic-covers/issue/38/).

*Fan comic —* **LeOnKay**, *The disguised Foal*. Its disguise premise is fan fiction, not an established character identity.

## Important moments

1. **Apple Bloom's classroom embarrassment — *Call of the Cutie* (S1E12).** Sun Glimmer is visible among Cheerilee's pupils during the cutie-mark lesson and Apple Bloom's uncomfortable school experience: the scene by which viewers identify this background filly. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=69q78WoBGUs) — scene timestamp unavailable.
2. **Back in magic class — *The FUNdamentals of Magic: Types of Magic* (short 1; 2017/2018).** Her later use among Celestia's young students links the distinctive design to another official G4 animation, without giving her a personal plot or dialogue. [Official Hasbro short](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HglM5ZmhUNE) — scene timestamp unavailable.

*There are no verified character-led turning points to add: her significance is as a recognizable background filly rather than a speaking protagonist.*
